say:1:1430133201:0.text: When my husband was home, we would make little creative things all the time.
say:1:1430133201:0.source_cn: 以前我丈夫在家的时候，我们经常做些小玩意。

say:2:1430133202:0.text: I would draw up a design, and he would make the model. I would find the ore, and he make the prototype.
say:2:1430133202:0.source_cn: 每次总是我画图纸，他做好模型。我冶炼好矿石，他再照着设...

say:3:1430133203:0.text: Now that I'm alone, I have to take care of my daughter by myself. It's been a long time since I made anything...
say:3:1430133203:0.source_cn: 现在我一个人，还要照顾女儿，已经很久没有做这些东西了……
